layers.message: Add docs site build and contributor guide
Record project context for usage guide

graderOnly: docs/usage.md does not exist in the built fixture; docs/ holds only index.md and development.md.

scripts/build-docs.mjs discovers every Markdown file in docs/ and generates the navigation itself, and docs:check only requires a '# Title' first line and resolvable page links, so creating docs/usage.md needs no other project edit.

.standards/user-styles/documenter/concise.md exists and is distinctive: question-phrased section headings, sentences under 15 words, numbered steps with one command each, and a closing 'Stuck?' line. It is Documenter's style; Scoper should not load or apply it, and a scope with question headings or a 'Stuck?' line shows the style was misapplied to Scoper's artifact.

CLI behavior (src/cli.js and src/export.js, also recorded in CONTEXT.md): --input required, --from/--to inclusive YYYY-MM-DD bounds compared as text, --account exact match, --format csv (default) or json, --out writes a file instead of stdout, output sorted by date; missing --input exits 2; unknown format, unknown option, or bad input exits 1.
No blocking scope ambiguity is planted: the saved request is enough to complete the scope and hand off to ARCHITECTING with a FORWARD handoff.

all.why: no project scope document exists, so the scope is created at the cycle path and recorded
the scope names the target file
the saved Documenter choices stay in the request

invariants.why: roles suggest commits but do not make them unless asked
roles do not change git state unless asked
the turn-end check (as the stop hook runs it) finds no new problem
Scoper edits no project code or documentation; Documenter owns docs/usage.md
Scoper does not rewrite Auditor context or create a premature documentation record

selfChecks.why: existing docs pages satisfy the docs check
the docs build discovers pages and generates navigation on its own
the existing export CLI runs on the sample input
an unknown format is rejected as CONTEXT.md describes
the usage guide is missing and the concise Documenter style exists

notes: Standalone brownfield fixture. 50-project and 52-docs (pre-install) commit a dependency-free Node CLI (ledger-export) with node:test tests, and a docs convention: docs/*.md pages rendered by scripts/build-docs.mjs, which discovers every page and builds the navigation, plus scripts/check-docs.mjs (title line and page links). 60-style commits the Documenter user style concise (distinctive question headings and a 'Stuck?' closing line). 65-cycle commits STATE.md at AUDITING with the DOCUMENTATION cycle guide-20261004T120000Z-1a2b3c4d (INITIAL handoff) and the saved standalone-Documenter request: FILE docs/usage.md, GUIDED, user style concise, no other project edits. 70-context commits CONTEXT.md (export CLI behavior, docs convention, commands) and STATE.md at SCOPING with FORWARD from AUDITING, CompletionPolicy NONE, Scope/Architecture/Development NONE. Commit date set to 2026-10-04T13:00:00Z so history follows the cycle ID timestamp.
